name: factoryfox
description: Find industrial suppliers and compare capabilities using source-backed evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Find suppliers with evidence for each match.
interface.longDescription: Search industrial suppliers, inspect public company profiles, and browse capabilities and countries. Compare supported requirements with unknowns, with links to profiles and evidence sources.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find suppliers for low-volume PCB assembly in Europe and show the evidence and requirements I should confirm.
